seoDescription: Your rooms are already deciding how you live. Petrina Salema fixes the rooms that shape daily life and guest stays. Homes and hospitality spaces, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.

statement.hook: Your rooms are already deciding how you live.
statement.support: I help people change what the rooms decide, for themselves and for their guests.

invite.hook: Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose.
invite.body: A few homes and hospitality spaces a year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.

newsletterDescription: A note now and then, when a room teaches something worth passing on.
